description: Philippines: Airport locations is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Philippines. The dataset contains location and classification of airports complied from Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines, Department of Transportation. Coverage: Philippines. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Philippines. Its tags are aviation, transportation. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2026-07-22 as the last metadata change. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
